name: Nightwolf destroys the Soulnado
description: Nightwolf arrives to disrupt the Soulnado, defeats Quan Chi, and knocks Bi-Han as Noob Saibot into the vortex. Bi-Han is pulled into it, the Soulnado destabilizes and explodes, and Nightwolf later reports that Earthrealm's souls are safe. This Event does not assert Bi-Han's death or final fate.
